question: The central government, in 2021, set up an eight-member panel for framing a new law for drugs, cosmetics and medical devices. Who headed that panel?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dr. VG Somani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The central government, in 2021, set up an **eight-member panel** for framing a new law for drugs, cosmetics and medical devices.
 
• **Dr. VG Somani** headed that panel.
 
• Dr. VG Somani is the** Drugs Controller General of India** (DCGI).
